title: Medaka Kuroiwa Is Impervious to My Charms Season 2 Reveals New Visual, Digest Video
content:
The upcoming Medaka Kuroiwa Is Impervious to My Charms Season 2 revealed a new premiere visual featuring the main character Mona Kawai on Wednesday. A digest video recapping the first season was also released.

Studio SynergySP will return to animate the sequel with Yoshiaki Okumura also returning as director. The cast will also reprise their roles:

• Ryota Iwasaki as Medaka Kuroiwa

• Yu Serizawa as Mona Kawai

• Sora Amamiya as Asahi Shonan

• Kana Hanazawa as Tsubomi Haruno

• Hinaki Yano as Tomo Namba

• Kaori Maeda as Minami Shirahama

Medaka Kuroiwa Is Impervious to My Charms anime is based on a manga written and illustrated by Ran Kuze. It was originally launched as a one-shot in Kodansha’s Weekly Shonen Magazine in December 2020, and later began serialization in the same magazine in May 2021. Kodansha USA is publishing the manga in English. Crunchyroll is streaming the first season, describing it as: For Mona Kawai, winning hearts and turning heads comes naturally. Everything changes when Medaka Kuroiwa, a new transfer student, arrives. He won’t even give Mona a second look, and it turns her life upside down! Mona tries everything she can to win Medaka over, even going to the extreme at times. Tune in to a new rom-com about a queen bee and an unfazed boy among the school’s halls.
author: Anime Corner

title: Hatsune Miku Connecting Puzzle TAMAGOTORI Deluxe Game Launches on October 29
content:
Crypton Future Media announced on Thursday that the Hatsune Miku Connecting Puzzle TAMAGOTORI Deluxe game will launch for the PlayStation 5, PlayStation 4, Xbox One, and PC via Steam and Microsoft Store on October 29. The game contains the original Hatsune Miku Connecting Puzzle TAMAGOTORI game along with its two DLC packs.

The game features egg-matching gameplay to reveal special illustrations.

The original game launched in 2022 for Switch.

Crypton Future Media and Good Smile Company 's Hatsune Miku Nendoroid Starry Party 3D party game will launch for the Switch 2 and PC via Steam in 2027.

COLORFUL STAGE! The Movie: A Miku Who Can't Sing ( Gekijо̄ban Project Sekai: Kowareta Sekai to Utaenai Miku , or The Broken World and a Miku Who Can't Sing), the anime film based on the Project Sekai: Colorful Stage feat. Hatsune Miku smartphone game , opened in Japan on January 17. It debuted at #2 and sold 232,500 tickets and earned 306,817,000 yen (about US$2.15 million in current conversion) in its first three days.

GKIDS acquired the film's North American theatrical rights, and initially screened the film in the U.S. in April 2025 and in Canada in May 2025. The company released the film digitally on Amazon Prime Video , AppleTV, Google Movies, YouTube Movies, and Fandango At Home . The company then released the Collector's Edition Blu-ray Disc set on April 14.

The Project Sekai: Colorful Stage feat. Hatsune Miku smartphone game launched in Japan in September 2020. The game is a collaboration between Sega , Crypton Future Media , and Colorful Palette , a subsidiary of Craft Egg . Sega and Colorful Palette released the game globally as Hatsune Miku: Colorful Stage! on iOS and Android devices in December 2021.

The game inspired a mini anime adaptation titled Petit Seka ( Puchi Seka ) . The anime had 10 episodes, and streamed for free on YouTube .

Hatsune Miku Project Diva Mega Mix ( Hatsune Miku: Project Diva Mega39's ) launched digitally in the West for Nintendo Switch game in May 2020. The game got a PC release in May 2022.

title: The Greatest Magicmaster's Retirement Plan TV Anime Casts Eri Yukimura
content:
The staff for the television anime of writer Izushiro and illustrator Ruria Miyuki 's The Greatest Magicmaster's Retirement Plan ( Saikyō Mahōshi no Inton Keikaku ) light novel series announced on Wednesday that the anime will air in the "Agaru Anime" programming block on CBC , TBS , and 26 other affiliated channels next year. The anime's staff also announced that Eri Yukimura is voicing Tesfia "Fia" Fable, an ice magic user and a first-year student at the magical institute Alus attends.

J-Novel Club is publishing the light novels in English and describes the story:

In a world where the Fiends run rampant... Magicmaster Alus Reigin, the young prodigy that has defeated more Fiends and reclaimed more of humanity's lost territory than anyone else alive, requests retirement from military service at age 16. But due to the twists and turns of fate surrounding his status as the No. 1 Magicmaster in the nation—the top Magicmaster out of more than 100,000—he ends up as a student at a special magical institute, hiding his identity and training his successors – a pair of beautiful Magicmaster girls! Not to mention continuing to defeat Fiends in secret.

The anime stars Yūto Uemura as protagonist Alus Reigin, and Yui Ogura as Loki Leevahl.

Yūsuke Suzuki ( This Monster Wants to Eat Me , Duel Masters Win ) is directing the anime at HOTLINE . Gigaemon Ichikawa ( Himitsu no AiPri , A Galaxy Next Door ) is in charge of series scripts, Yūki Kitajima ( The 100 Girlfriends Who Really, Really, Really, Really, Really Love You , Kakegurui , One Piece episode key animator) is designing the characters, and Takatoshi Hamano ( IDOLiSH7 , Chainsmoker Cat , Ishura ) is the sound director.

To commemorate the novels' anime adaptation, a prequel manga titled Saikyō Mahōshi no Inton Keikaku Zero -Hajimari no Hishi-roku- ( The Greatest Magicmaster's Retirement Plan Zero -The Secret History of the Beginning-) is scheduled to launch this winter. Karu Yoneshiro is again drawing the manga. The manga will depict Alus' life before he enrolled in the magic academy, and will connect to the main story.

Izushiro started publishing the novels on the Shōsetsuka ni Narō website in 2015. Hobby Japan published the 20th novel volume in December 2025.

Yoneshiro's The Greatest Magicmaster's Retirement Plan - The Alternative - manga launched in Square Enix 's Manga UP! app in 2020. The series ended with its 10th compiled book volume that shipped in January 2024. Comikey publishes the manga in English digitally.

Yoneshiro's manga is the second manga adaptation of the novels. Yū Uonuma 's first manga adaptation serialized in Hobby Japan 's website, and ran for two volumes.

title: Millennium Family TV Anime Casts Haruna Mikawa
content:
The staff for the television anime of Sho Kasugai 's Millennium Family ( Odoru Sennen Kazoku ) manga announced on Tuesday that Haruna Mikawa voices Raine, the second daughter of the Benfield family.

The anime will star:

• Rikuya Yasuda as Theo

• Katsuyuki Konishi as Hayden

• Ryōta Suzuki as Hugo

• Lynn as Eve

• Taihi Kimura as Noel

Masato Jinbo ( Fate/kaleid liner Prisma Illya 2wei! /2wei Herz!/3rei!! , Chaos;Child , The Rising of The Shield Hero Season 2 ) is directing the anime at PartsCraft , and is also supervising the scripts. Hiroshi Yoneda ( Fate/kaleid liner Prisma Illya: Vow in the Snow ) is the character designer and chief animation director.

AI localization company Orange Inc. 's e-bookstore service emaqi licensed the manga, and it describes the story:

Seven immortal siblings born in England possess humanity's ultimate dream: eternal life. But their gift makes them targets for the criminal underworld, corrupt hospitals, and international military organizations! After centuries apart, this extraordinary family reunites for a thrilling new chapter in their lives.

The anime will air on TBS and other stations.

Kasugai launched the manga in Shōnengahōsha 's Young King Ours magazine in March 2021. Shōnengahōsha released the manga's ninth compiled book volume on July 30.

title: Masaki Andō's Mojiponika! Manga Ends on November 25
content:
Manga author Masaki Andō announced on Friday that his Mojiponika! manga will end in the next issue of Kodansha 's Afternoon magazine on November 25.

The comedy manga centers on Tsumugu, the son of an embroidery shop owner. He gets paid a big amount of money by Gina, a foreign exchange student who has a deep passion for kanji characters and yakuza films, to stitch kanji characters on her tokkōfuku (a traditional style of uniform mainly worn by gang members). Before his encounter with Gina, Tsumugu never thought it was a problem that he cannot read some kanji characters, but through her intense love for kanji, Tsumugu begins to discover the characters' meanings.

Andō launched the manga in Afternoon magazine in May 2025. Kodansha published the manga's first compiled book volume in October 2025, and the third volume on August 21.

Andō launched the Yatogame-chan Kansatsu Nikki manga in Ichijinsha 's Comic Rex magazine in May 2016. The series ended in September 2022. Ichijinsha published the manga's 13th and final volume in December 2022. The series highlights regional cultural differences from the area of Nagoya, Aichi. The manga's title character was appointed as a Nagoya Tourism Cultural Exchange Mission Ambassador in March 2017.

The manga had inspired a four-season television anime . The first season of the anime premiered in April 2019. The second season, titled Yatogame-chan Kansatsu Nikki 2 Satsume , premiered in January 2020, and also aired for 12 episodes. The third season, Yatogame-chan Kansatsu Nikki 3 Satsume , premiered in January 2021. The fourth season , Yatogame-chan Kansatsu Nikki 4 Satsume , premiered in April 2022. Crunchyroll streamed all four seasons as they aired in Japan.

title: 5 1990s Classic Anime That Are Impossible to Stream Anywhere
content:
There’s no denying that the 1990s were a revolutionary era for the anime industry, but unfortunately, many of the classics couldn’t stand the test of time. The decade completely shifted the global market since several shows became popular in the West due to television broadcasts. As the demand grew, the anime industry quickly began to evolve, especially throughout the 1990s. Anime released during that era were a lot more experimental since they allowed directors and animators more artistic freedom. Compared to now, when the industry is oversaturated with anime shows and films, the 1990s released fewer but iconic shows that are loved even to this day.

However, the reason many of them were more or less forgotten by the world was because of their limited availability. It became increasingly difficult to watch those shows over the years since the streaming platforms never picked them up for international fans. Even if these platforms did manage to somehow make them available, they were eventually removed and never to be seen again . Despite having critical acclaim and some of the best stories of all time, you can’t stream these 1990s classics anywhere in the U.S.

5) Hunter x Hunter (1999)

While there’s no denying that the 2011 reboot version is a more popular and polished version of the story , the original anime had a different kind of charm. It featured the classic 1990s grainy visuals that can’t be replicated today. The story is set in a world where Hunters specialize in a variety of fields, including treasure hunting, cooking, and more, as they continue to pursue their dreams and interests. The original TV run was for two years until 2001, when the anime ended halfway through the Yorknew City Arc. Later on, the Original Net Animation version of the anime adapted the story up until the Greed Island Arc before it fully caught up with the manga. Due to the manga hiatuses, the anime never returned with the Chimera Ant Arc. Instead, studio Madhouse took over the anime and retold the story with modern animation. The hype was so great that the original version was eventually forgotten, despite being an incredible adaptation with stunning visuals.

4) Slayers

Slayers is another one of those series whose popularity diminished over the years, but among avid anime fans, it’s still considered one of the best fantasy Shonen series. The story strikes a perfect blend of comedy, action, and adventure, which is rarely seen in the industry anymore. Following the classic tropes that are enjoyable to this day, the story follows sorceress Lina Inverse, who travels all across the world stealing treasures from bandits using her immense powers. However, just when she is about to attack her new group of victims, swordsman Gourry Gabriev enters the scene since he believes Lina is in trouble. While naively trying to help a girl in need, he confronts the brigands and is determined to escort her to Atlas City, her next destination. As the story continues, the duo’s unlikely partnership sets off a chain of chaotic yet thrilling adventures across a world filled with magic, monsters, and mysterious artifacts.

3) Serial Experiments Lain

Serial Experiments Lain remains one of the most mind-bending psychological thrillers of all time and became a cult classic after it was premiered in 1998. Known for its gruesome, thought-provoking elements, this award-winning anime series leaves a lasting impact on viewers in just 13 episodes. Based on an original story, the anime reached one of the most satisfying conclusions of all time. Since the story never needed a sequel to tie up the loose ends, it makes the show a perfect binge-worthy watch for viewers. This exceptionally well-written story blurs the line between reality and the virtual world as it explores relevant themes of the age of digital life that was way ahead of its time. Unfortunately, modern anime fans might never be able to experience the brilliance of this masterpiece since none of the major streaming platforms have any plans for bringing it back to fans across the world.

2) Outlaw Star

Space western anime shows centering around adventure were all the rage in the 1990s, and there’s no doubt that this theme is appreciated even to this day, as witnessed by the huge popularity of Cowboy Bebop . When this theme was at the height of its popularity, Outlaw Star was released, and it became a massive hit. Unfortunately, the anime didn’t stand the test of time, unlike Cowboy Bebop , even though both series were released in the same year. While Outlaw Star is more or less forgotten among new anime fans, it still has a small but dedicated fanbase. However, this underrated gem was once one of the most popular space anime, praised for its intriguing adventure with a blend of fun and space exploration. The major reason why this anime was forgotten is that fans in the U.S. have no means to watch this anywhere, due to licensing issues.

1) The File of Young Kindaichi

Fans of Detective Conan would have easily fallen in love with this late 1990s mystery series adapted by Toei Animation, the same studio behind classics such as One Piece and Dragon Ball . That is, considering that it wasn’t removed from Crunchyroll several years ago. Although The File of Young Kindaichi never got the global recognition it deserved, it was considered one of the best long-running crime dramas during that era. The anime even released a sequel season in 2014, which again failed to attract a wider audience in the West. The story centers around Hajime Kindaichi, who appears to be an average high school student at first glance. Although his appearance isn’t striking, he is actually the grandson of someone who was once the greatest detective in Japan, as he continues his grandfather’s legacy by solving mysteries by travelling through remote islands, eerie towns, dangerous seas, and all kinds of hostile places.

Which 1990s anime classic do you wish were available to stream on major platforms? Do you think these forgotten gems deserve a wider audience? Let us know your picks in the comments!

title: Yome ga Kuru Artist saku Launches New Kimi to Sakura no Hanataba wo Manga
content:
Kodansha 's Magazine Pocket platform announced on X (formerly Twitter ) on Saturday that Yome ga Kuru! (My Wife is Coming!) artist saku will launch a new series titled Kimi to Sakura no Hanataba wo (A Bouquet of Cherry Blossoms and You) on the platform on November 1.

saku launched the Yome ga Kuru! manga with Yasunori Mitsunaga in Shueisha 's Grand Jump Mucha magazine in April 2025. Shueisha shipped the second compiled book volume on September 17.

saku drew the Betsusekai no Kirakira Dōki ga Ecchi na Illust o Kaiteiru manga in 2021, Senpai! Waza to Janain Desu! in 2022, Kimi ni Koisuru San Shimai in 2023, and the Boku o Shiritasugiru Shimizu-san manga in April 2024.

title: Dragon Ball Super: Beerus Is Already a Huge Disappointment Before Its Biggest Battle
content:
Dragon Ball Super : Beerus is already a huge disappointment in its Episode 3, and the main battle between Goku and Beerus hasn’t even begun. The anime returned this month as part of the Fall 2026 lineup, but instead of continuing the story with a sequel, Toei Animation released a remake version of the previous arcs. Since the anime returned after more than eight years, it’s no surprise that the hype was greater than ever, even if the new anime was a remake rather than a sequel. The biggest reason why fans were hyped over the anime’s return is that it aimed to fix the biggest issues with the original anime adaptations, including the animation quality and the pacing.

The remake is following the original story written by Akira Toriyama, the original manga creator, while also focusing on better visuals and fight choreography. A few episodes have already been out, and it’s obvious the new version is drawn from scratch instead of simply polishing the visuals. While the title is Dragon Ball Super: Beerus , the anime will retell the story of the Battle of Gods, Resurrection F, and Universe 6 arcs during its run. However, despite fan expectations, the remake isn’t as good as the studio claimed, and the third episode made it quite clear.

Dragon Ball Super: Beerus Disappoints With Vegeta’s Character Development

One look at the episode and you can tell easily why it was flamed online by everyone. Not even the biggest fans of the anime could defend the third episode of the remake, and it’s really no surprise considering the rushed pacing and the jarring visuals. During the episode, Beerus arrived on Earth after crushing Goku on King Kai’s planet. However, Vegeta was there to keep things under control. King Kai had already warned him that the God of Destruction would be arriving on the planet, and it’d be best to avoid angering him. In order to save those around him and the planet, Vegeta was even willing to let go of his pride and do all the unnecessary jumping around, even if it made him look like a fool.

He served Beerus and Whis and did everything he could to make sure that none of the other Z Fighters would offend him in any way. Whether it was serving them a plate or dancing, Vegeta utterly humiliated himself in front of everyone. However, while some fans may think it was cringe or irrelevant, these moments highlighted how far he had come since his introduction. Someone as prideful as him was doing everything he could to save the planet, even if it meant bending to Beerus’ will.

As a child, Vegeta had already witnessed the horror Beerus invoked in those around him, which is all the more reason why those moments made sense and added to his character depth. However, most of those moments were original, which is why the anime removed them in the remake. Even so, there’s no denying that some of those added more to the character depth as compared to simply rushing things down and skipping over to the main battle.

Dragon Ball Super: Beerus Fails to Keep Its Promise of a More Polished Version

It’s not just Vegeta, but the remake made every side character non-existent, which is a huge disappointment. The anime movie, Dragon Ball Z: Battle of Gods , was released before the Dragon Ball Super manga. While the movie didn’t actually follow the manga, it was already considered canon since the script and everything else was overseen by Akira Toriyama. Later on, the Battle of Gods was included in the manga for only four chapters, but the anime extended the arc with more scenes. The anime series highlighted the side characters even more, especially before Goku jumped into action. Not to mention that it also changed the moment where Beerus slapped Bulma.

Instead of hitting her purposefully, the remake showed that Beerus accidentally hit her with his shoulder , which got Vegeta completely enraged. In the original anime, Vegeta tried his best to avoid a confrontation until he saw his wife being hit by the God of Destruction. Despite his fear and knowing he couldn’t win, he jumped straight into action, landing some of his most powerful attacks on Beerus. The remake was a great idea, but the execution was poorly handled. Some of the scenes remain the same while others changed completely. Not to mention that the visuals and filters aren’t as good as the anime promised, which is yet another major disappointment.

The anime had quite a lot of time to fix the issues with the previous versions, but it still didn’t change some of the drawings that needed corrections. While the remake was supposed to be a better version of the anime, at this point it’s pretty evident what fans prefer. Since the remake turned out to be a huge disappointment in only the first few weeks, there’s no denying that the next episodes will feature the same jarring color scheme and rushed pacing that completely took the heart and soul of the story away.

Do you think Dragon Ball Super: Beerus can turn things around later since Episode 3 has already raised concerns about how it will handle the biggest battles? Share your thoughts in the comments below.

title: Phantom Busters Anime Reveals First Teaser Visual, Main Staff and Cast
content:
Phantom Busters anime has revealed the first teaser visual, along with introducing the main voice cast and staff. The anime was announced last month, and it is set to release in 2027.

The announced cast includes:

• Nobuhiko Okamoto as Mogari Shishikuno

• Natsuki Hanae as Eugene Korekishi

• Koki Uchiyama as Kaoru Kanzaki

• Ryota Suzuki as Kotaro Tamon

Chika Nagaoka is directing the anime, with Takahiro Kishida and Rina Iwamoto as character designers. TOHO animation STUDIO is in charge of the animation production. Nagaoka previously worked on Detective Conan: The Million-dollar Pentagram and Tamon’s B-Side . You can see the new teaser visual:

Phantom Busters is a Japanese manga series written and illustrated by Neoshoco. It has been serialized in Shueisha’s Jump Square since August 2023, while VIZ Media began publishing the English version in October 2025. The manga surpassed 1.4 million copies in circulation, including digital editions. VIZ describes the story: In search of a fourth member for the club, Mogari, Eugene, and new recruit Kaoru Kanzaki set their sights on Kotaro Tamon, a classmate who seems to be able to talk to ghosts. Unfortunately, Kotaro’s got some major problems communicating with living humans! Will Kotaro be able to overcome his anxiety and join the Phantom Busters?

title: Eito Chida Launches New Hoshibarai no Chidori Manga
content:
The November issue of Square Enix 's Gangan Joker magazine announced last Thursday that Eito Chida will launch a new series titled Hoshibarai no Chidori in the next issue on November 20.

The battle fantasy manga follows a boy named Chidori who wants to shine and another boy Shin who believes his brilliance makes him a hero. Together, they face star spirits, who devour wishes.

Chida ended the Bottom-Tier Character Tomozaki manga adaptation with the sixth compiled book volume in April 2021. Comikey publishes the series in English digitally.

The first anime premiered in January 2021. Funimation streamed the anime as it aired in Japan, and it also streamed an English dub. The second television anime season aired in January 2024. Crunchyroll streamed a dub for the season.

The anime also received two OVA episodes that were bundled with the third and fourth Blu-ray Disc and DVD home video volumes of the anime in May and June 2021, respectively. Funimation also streamed those episodes.

Chida ended the manga adaptation of P.A. Works ' Hanasaku Iroha franchise in September 2012. Square Enix shipped the fifth and final volume in December 2012.

The 26-episode television series premiered in April 2011, and Crunchyroll streamed the series outside of Japan as it aired. The series expired on Crunchyroll in 2018. NIS America released the anime series on DVD and Blu-ray Disc in two sets in 2013. It also released the 2013 Hanasaku Iroha: Home Sweet Home anime film.
